shots.focal_element: Rounded, drop-shadowed app window of the Teams Hub (Marketing team overview, then Priorities and Workload tabs) floating on a grainy magenta-orange-blue gradient
on_screen_text: Welcome to the Marketing Team Hub!
shots.typography: No added captions; only native product UI text (small sans-serif, bold section headings, sentence case, normal tracking). Font guess (low confidence): Inter-like UI sans.
shots.what_happens: Long 16.6 s demo over the Teams Hub VO (w108-w158): cursor hovers the Marketing overview (members, members-online chart), the page scrolls down to the Feed and back up, then the tab switches to a per-person Priorities card grid (around w119-w123) and to a colour-coded Workload capacity grid (around w144-w146); a horizontal motion-blur whip at about 55.5 s swaps to a different workspace's sprint list where the cursor opens a sidebar '+' menu, and the frame dims at the end as a modal begins to appear (subfolders line, w150-w158). The internal whip is inside this single code-detected shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a screen recording inside a 16:9 rounded window with a soft drop shadow, centred on an animated grainy multi-colour gradient, and switch tabs on VO keywords, using a 6-8 frame horizontal motion-blur whip to jump to the next recording.

shots.focal_element: Centred 'Create Folder' modal over a dimmed sprint list, with the Name field filled 'Releases'
on_screen_text: Use Folders to organize your Lists, Docs, and more.
shots.typography: Native UI only: modal title in semibold sans, sentence case; helper text and field labels in regular weight, small size, normal tracking. No added overlay type.
shots.what_happens: As the VO says 'subfolders are finally here on Beta' (w159-w164), the Create Folder modal sits over a dimmed list; the name 'Releases' is typed, the location is 'Team | Kanban', and the cursor moves to click 'Create' (around w165-w170); the last frame shows the resulting empty list view.
shots.build_rebuild: Show the recorded app window centred on the gradient, dim the background layer to about 60% when the modal opens, and let the cursor travel to the primary 'Create' button timed to the 'add another layer' clause of the VO.

shots.focal_element: Sidebar hierarchy showing the new nested 'Releases' folder with a 'List' inside, under Team | Kanban
shots.what_happens: The empty 'List' view inside the new Releases subfolder is shown (Import: Statuses / Views / Automations / Custom Fields bar); the cursor drifts left toward the sidebar tree, landing near 'Team | Scrum' by the end, under VO 'folders to organize projects, phases' (w172-w176).
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the centred window on the newly created nested folder for about 3 s while the cursor glides toward the sidebar, setting up the next zoom-in on the tree.

shots.focal_element: Zoomed-in sidebar tree: ClickUp 4.0 > Team | Kanban > Releases > List, and Team | Scrum > Multiplayer Mode > Sprint 1
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes in so the sidebar fills the frame; the cursor expands 'Team | Scrum' and hovers 'Multiplayer Mode' (a 'Multiplayer Mode' tooltip appears), then opens Sprint 1, revealing its In Progress task list, illustrating nested folders keeping 'complex work structured' (w178-w186).
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the recording to about 2.5x, anchored on the sidebar so the nested folder tree fills the frame edge to edge, and keep the cursor clicks readable at that zoom.

shots.focal_element: Task detail page 'NovaCore Solutions' (Account task type) with its Custom Fields block and Activity panel
shots.typography: Native UI only: task title in large bold sans, sentence case; field labels in small regular sans. No added overlay type.
shots.what_happens: The zoomed sidebar view pulls back out to the full framed window (sprint list), then by about 70.5 s (near SFX x005) the content switches to the 'NovaCore Solutions' task; the cursor works the Custom Fields block (Account Owner, Account Tier 'Gold', Renewal Date) and scrolls to show Department and Summary fields, under 'Tasks themselves are smarter too' (w187-w192); a blur zoom starts at the end of the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Pull the camera from 2.5x back to 1x on the framed window, cut to the task-detail recording on a beat, and finish with a 4-6 frame zoom-blur push into the Custom Fields block to hand off to the next shot.
